title: Waterfall
author: MollaAliod
why: Shirahige Falls (Shirogane Onsen, Biei) in deep winter seen from the Blue River bridge: water seeping from the cliff into the turquoise Biei River, snow-loaded spruces, rising steam — exact place + snow, landscape. (Title is just 'Waterfall'; tagged shirogane/snow; visually unmistakable.)
